english.title: Registered person fail to display Care Quality Commission performance rating on premises providing regulated activities
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[service provider]_
(B)_[registered manager]_

in respect of a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), when there was not displayed at each premises from which

(C)_[you]_
(D)_[the service provider]_

provided regulated activities at least one sign showing the most recent rating by the Commission that related to

(E)_[your]_
(F)_[the service provider's]_

performance at those premises in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20A(3), 22(1)(e) and 23(5A) of the Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
were the registered person in respect of a registered activity
when there was not displayed at each premises from which the service provider provided regulated activities
at least one sign showing the most recent rating by the Commission
that related to the service provider's performance at those premises

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 8(1) and (2) provides that a registered person must comply with regulations 9 to 20A in carrying on a regulated activity, unless the thing to be done has by another registered person in relation to the regulated activity concerned.
(ii) As per regulation 22(4), it is a defence for a registered person to prove that they took all reasonable steps and exercised all due diligence to prevent the breach.
